description.narrative: The development objective of the Accelerating Sustainable Energy Transition Program for East Asia and Pacific is to help accelerate renewable energy scale up in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) countries, including through regional power trade. The project comprises of three components. The first component is regional renewable energy policy support and climate financing; the second component is regional power trade; and the third component is knowledge sharing, consultations, and capacity building.
To help accelerate renewable energy scale up in the ASEAN countries, including through regional power trade.
